message: 新・言霊

name: Ardin
message: 「Guhah... The sky is pitch black...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Because it is night.」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh? What's with this guy? He's not a ghost at all. What a waste of a fight.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Isn't it fine? Wandering around the school in the middle of the night with his chest wide open, he's definitely a pervert!」

name: Ria
message: 「That's right. Let's just say this time we delivered divine punishment to a suspicious person as the Student Council, not the Crusaders.」

name: Ardin
message: 「D-Did I just get beaten to a pulp over a misunderstanding...?」

name: Ardin
message: 「Dammit! I'm channeling all this misplaced rage into my legs and running away at full sprint!!」

name: Synn
message: 「True to his word, he bolted. Oh well, whatever.」

name: Paqy
message: 「By the way, about the 'what' in 'Harete teibou nani wo kiku'--'Under clear skies by the embankment, what do you hear?'--」

name: Paqy
message: 「The spirit that ascended let the kind students hear a sound of gratitude.」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh my? What a lovely story!」

name: Paqy
message: 「I'd never do anything to scare my beloved Ria-chan.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Still, things only went well this time by sheer luck. If it'd gone wrong, there could've been a curse.」

name: Paqy
message: 「So make sure you never play Kokkuri-san half-heartedly, got it?」

name: Everyone
message: 「Okaaay!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nya-kay!」

name: Pasta
message: 「A-Anyway, setting that aside... I-I lost, nya, and in the most uncool way possible!」

name: Pasta
message: 「That muscle-brain is a completely useless man, nya! Looks like Pasta has no choice but to handle this herself, nya!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Tonight, though, I'm going home and sleeping under the kotatsu, nyan.」
